text:
Tess R: quick postmortem follow-up from the late-night cascade. collecting owners for alert tuning and suppression follow-through.
Omar K: saw repeated pages stemming from the same quota-exhausted error across AZs, dedupe didn't group because the alert fingerprint included instance_id.
Ravi N: root cause was a combination of a short dedupe window (20s), and a low paging threshold on the quota util metric. also kvcache flapped under the load spike.
Tess R: propose short action list (small PRs preferred): 1) change quota-util paging threshold 72% -> 86% and add 3m cooldown. owner: Omar K. ETA: 48h. 2) change dedupe fingerprint to exclude instance_id and add global window 180s. owner: Ravi N. ETA: 72h. 3) add kvcache-miss-rate alert (separate from tokens) and a playbook note for priming. owner: Tess R. ETA: 1 week.
Omar K: ack. I'll open PR with rationale and include load replay steps. will attach perf graphs.
Ravi N: ack. will create a feature flag for the dedupe behavior and add unit tests that assert grouping across AZs. sample config: ```yaml
alert_dedupe:
  window_seconds: 180
  fingerprint_exclude: [instance_id]
```
Tess R: for the kvcache metric I'll add a dashboard heatmap and an alert if miss-rate spikes sustained for 5m. also add a one-line runbook for oncall.
CI Bot: INCIDENT-7891 auto-resolved. Please assign postmortem owners.
Tess R: another follow-up: schedule a weekly sweep that marks alerts that fired >5 times in 24h as "suppression-candidate" for manual review. owner: Omar K. ETA: 2 weeks.
Omar K: will add a cron job that posts candidates to #alerts-review and creates a board card. will not auto-suppress without human review.
Ravi N: suggest a canary suppression rollout (10% of alerts) to monitor false negatives. owner: Ravi N. ETA: 2 weeks.
Tess R: putting all items into the postmortem board and adding calendar reminders. will run a 15m sync in 48h to check PR progress. close thread when PRs linked in the board. :white_check_mark:
Omar K: PR opened: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/1452 (threshold + cooldown).
Ravi N: branch created: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-global-180s (feature-flagged).
Tess R: kvcache metric PR: https://git.redwood/observability/pull/322  adds heatmap and alert rule.
CI Bot: Reminder: weekly alert-cleanup scheduled Fridays 09:00 UTC.
Tess R: thanks team, closing for now. ping if anything urgent pops up.
